title: a value-object param (workflow `create`, aggregate operation) whose single-field or cross-field invariant refuses the value — the wire 422 at `/<param>/<member>`, the body never runs
note: #5369 / #5333: elixir's value-object constructor judged only single-field rules, and a workflow value-object param was cast but never judged — a reversed range ran the body and persisted.  Both rules are named so the refusal's text and code are the same on every backend.
